app_tagline: Your Immich albums as TV shows in Jellyfin
auth_intro: Sign in as the Immich user that albums are shared with for the media server.
auth_password_hint: The password is checked by Immich and not stored. The app keeps its own Immich key, only for naming people and accepting invitations.
auth_with_key: Sign in with an API key
auth_key_hint: For an Immich that signs in only through OAuth. Without the permissions person.update and clusterGroupRequest.create the page can show people but not name them.
error_secret_key_missing: Signing in is not set up: SHOWRUNNER_SECRET_KEY is missing in .env.
error_not_the_app_user: Only the Immich user whose API key the app syncs with can sign in.
error_immich_invalid_api_key: Immich does not accept this API key.
error_immich_password_login_failed: Immich did not let in with a password; it may sign in only through OAuth. Use an API key.
status_interval: The app syncs every {minutes} min, and fully once an hour.
status_held_text: It would remove {removed} of {before} links. That looks like a wrong API key or user rather than albums that are no longer shared, so nothing was changed.
status_force_text: {removed} of {before} links will be removed from the folder of the media server, with their shows in Jellyfin. The videos in Immich are not touched, and the shows come back when the albums are shared again.
status_skipped_hint: These videos of shared albums did not become episodes.
skip_no_path_mapping: its folder is not in SHOWRUNNER_PATH_MAP
status_pictures_hint: They are tried again on the next pass.
status_foreign_hint: Something the app did not write is at these paths of the output folder, so it did not overwrite or remove it.
shows_hint: Every album shared with the user of the app becomes a show in Jellyfin. Open one to change how it looks there: its title, its seasons and its episodes.
shows_empty_text: Share an album with videos with the Immich user of the app.
show_title_label: Title of the show in Jellyfin
show_title_hint: Empty: the name of the album, “{name}”.
show_seasons_hint: Changing this gives the episodes new numbers; their watched marks in Jellyfin may be lost.
show_hide: Leave this album out of Jellyfin
show_saved: Saved. Jellyfin will have it in a minute.
episode_reset: Back to the title and order from Immich
people_hint: People shared with the user of the app in Immich. Only those with a name here are in Jellyfin, marked with the prefix; the names of the owners stay as they are.
people_read_only: Signed in with an API key without the permissions to name people: names can be changed in Immich, descriptions here.
people_group_unknown: Not known: sign in with the password to see it.
people_group_members: The user of the app is in a group with: {names}.
people_group_alone: The user of the app is in no group with others yet: nobody can share people with it.
people_group_hint: Only members of one group can share people. A user is in one group only: all owners whose people should be in Jellyfin have to be in the same group.
people_invitation_blocked: The user of the app is already in a group with others. Joining another group takes it out of the current one, and the people shared there are lost for Jellyfin. If that is what you want, accept it in Immich.
people_empty_text: An owner of albums shares people with the user of the app in Immich: People, a person, Manage access.
people_name_hint: Written to Immich for the user of the app only. Empty: the person is not in Jellyfin.
people_description_hint: Shown on the page of the person in Jellyfin. Kept by the app; Immich has no such field.
error_cannot_write: This sign-in can not change Immich. Sign in with the password.
error_sign_in_again: Immich did not accept the key of the app. Sign out and sign in again.
error_show_not_found: This album is not shared with the user of the app.
